title: Ipv4 parse
statement: Validate exactly four canonical decimal IPv4 octets separated by dots. Each octet is 0..255, has no sign or whitespace, and has no leading zero unless it is 0. Return accepted holding its unsigned 32-bit numeric value in the declared integer field (0..4294967295); return rejected(malformed) for any invalid input.
constraints: All text is ASCII; unless a narrower task bound is stated, each input string has at most 1000 characters.
Preserve the exact declared public types and solve signature. Helpers are allowed.
No input/output, exception throwing, panic, tests, or static diagnostic suppression in the submitted source.
